name: Threadbrief

cover.alt: Threadbrief: a mint thread leads to a stack of notes labeled Goal, Done and Next.

description: Keep a running report for each agent session: goal, result, confirmation and next step. Update at a milestone, not on every message.

settings.title: Show the plugin icon
settings.description: Show the plugin mark on the settings gear. The sidebar tab is unchanged.

settings.title: Load briefs only on click
settings.description: Use Load brief or Refresh brief in the panel. Switching sessions and finishing a turn never read reports or history automatically. New worktrees do not open the panel.

settings.title: Report format
settings.description: Describe the language, layout and emphasis for new reports. Leave empty for Goal, Result, Confirmation and Next. Changing this does not run a model.

settings.title: Read recent agent replies
settings.description: Show the latest update and recent work when there’s no saved session report.

settings.title: Read paired session history
settings.description: Allow Threadbrief to read the selected session from its paired Orca server. Recap requests stay on that server.

settings.title: Recap strategy
settings.description: Brief prepares a short recap; Detailed asks for a longer handoff. Neither starts an agent until you approve the preview. Instant only shows existing text.

settings.title: Preferred recap agent
settings.description: The installed Orca agent selected in Threadbrief. Empty uses Orca’s default.

settings.title: Custom recap model (optional)
settings.description: Leave empty to use the agent’s usual model. To pin another, choose Model → Add a model in Threadbrief or enter its exact identifier here.

settings.title: Reasoning effort
settings.description: Leave empty for the agent default. The Threadbrief panel lists levels reported for the pinned model on the selected host.

settings.title: Open for new worktrees
settings.description: Open the panel only when the new worktree has a saved summary.

settings.title: Pause updates while reading
settings.description: Keep the displayed brief while you read it. Turn off to show each new result immediately, even when the panel has focus.

settings.title: Show profile commands
settings.description: Show optional workflow actions for projects that match an enabled profile. This does not affect summaries.

settings.title: Profile commands: show first
settings.description: Choose the first button shown for a profile command. Both buttons remain available. Neither runs the command.
